description: This file contains tests for requirements helper functions related to environment, platform, binary, and configuration requirements. It uses the 'vitest' testing framework to define various test cases for functions like 'resolveMissingBins', 'evaluateRequirements', and others, verifying their behavior with different inputs.

methods.name: buildConfigChecks
methods.description: Constructs an array of configuration check objects with their satisfaction status.

methods.name: evaluateRequirements
methods.description: Evaluates various required requirements against system/environment state, returns required and missing categories.

methods.name: evaluateRequirementsFromMetadata
methods.description: Derives required and missing requirements from provided metadata, local environment info, and predicate functions.

methods.name: evaluateRequirementsFromMetadataWithRemote
methods.description: Extends metadata evaluation by incorporating remote environment predicates and platform info.

methods.name: resolveMissingBins
methods.description: Determines which required binaries are missing based on local and remote availability functions.

methods.name: resolveMissingAnyBins
methods.description: Identifies any missing binaries from a required list, considering local and remote availability.

methods.name: resolveMissingEnv
methods.description: Checks which environment variables from a list are not satisfied.

methods.name: resolveMissingOs
methods.description: Identifies missing OS requirements based on local and remote platform info.
